name: Greene's Blueberry Patch
description: Greene's Blueberry Patch is a small farm in 989 Junaluska Rd, NC. It grows Pumpkins, Corn, Herbs, Flowers, and Honey, with seasonal availability through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
